name: a goal becomes a PRD, then tickets wired to it

inputs.goal: Ship operator failover for the Solana staking router: a PRD, then the Jira tickets for it

acceptance: the tickets come from the PRD

expect: plan.md has exactly two items: pm/prd, then pm/jira-tickets, each with why it is needed
the router runs without stopping for the PM (two items, no high-risk mode)
a pm/prd child and a pm/jira-tickets child exist; the tickets child's plan input is {"$from": <the PRD child>, "output": "prd"} and its depends_on names the PRD child
the PRD child's prd.md passes check_doc.py --standard pm:standards/prd and has a requirement on operator failover
the router's own result has no actions; ticket actions, if any, belong to the jira-tickets child
